title: Astro inlines stylesheets by default, which breaks CSP default-src 'self'
rule: Keep build.inlineStylesheets: 'never' and never add inline <style>/<script> or set:html styles; the dist test asserts no inline style or script.
rationale: #1: Astro's default 'auto' inlined global.scss into every page, which a CSP of default-src 'self' blocks, so the site would render unstyled.

title: Tests must exercise the built site, not a stale dist or a reused dev server
rule: Run npm run build before npm run test; Playwright serves astro preview on its own port with reuseExistingServer: false; assert shipped output (computed styles, dist files), not source text.
rationale: #1: the token parity test read SCSS source only, and the smoke tests could reuse a running astro dev on 4321 or an old dist and pass falsely.
